title: GM -> Steven Slate Drums note map
comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for GM -> SSD note translation. Everything downstream
(the .mid transforms, the .drm drum map writer, the .dawproject writer, the
renderer's preview mapping) reads THIS file. Change a note here, rebuild, done.
STATUS: PROVISIONAL. The core-kit entries below assume SSD's GM-compatible
layout, which is the correct starting guess but has NOT been checked against
the operator's actual kit. Entries marked 'awaiting-operator' have no target
at all and are inert until filled in.
To verify: in SSD, play each pad and read the note number, then set 'to' and
flip 'confidence' to 'verified'. Run `./sb map doctor` to see what's left.

entries.note: GM has two kicks; both fold to the one SSD kick.
GM 'Electric Snare' folded onto the acoustic snare.
Second GM ride folded onto the one SSD ride bow.

articulations._comment: SSD articulations with no GM equivalent. They have no 'gm' key so they are never hit by a straight remap - the transforms reference them BY NAME (e.g. ghost_notes uses 'snare_ghost'). Fill 'to' in and they light up.

conditional._comment: Velocity-conditional routing, applied BEFORE the flat entries above. First match wins. Disabled until the referenced articulation has a real note number - a disabled rule is skipped silently, so this is safe to ship unverified.

rules.note: Route quiet GM snares to SSD's dedicated ghost articulation instead of relying on velocity alone.

choke_groups._comment: Notes that mutually cut each other off. Used by the .drm writer and by transforms.resolve_chokes to stop overlapping hi-hat states ringing together.
